user.title: Add a tracked device
user.description: GPS Timeline archives the location history of one entity in a dedicated database. Archived data is only deleted when you confirm it.

data_description.entity_id: Any entity exposing latitude/longitude attributes, e.g. device_tracker.my_phone or person.alice.
data_description.places_entity: Places integration sensor whose labels are archived alongside the GPS points.
data_description.activity_entity: Sensor whose state describes the current activity, e.g. walking or driving.
data_description.subject_kind: What this device tracks: person, topic, or object.
data_description.subject_name: Name of the subject, e.g. Yacin or Car. Shown as an attribute on the tracker.
data_description.accuracy_threshold: GPS fixes with an accuracy worse than this are ignored. Set to 0 to keep every fix.

attach.title: Archived data found
attach.description: Archived location history without a tracker exists in the GPS Timeline database. Attach it to this new tracker to continue the old timeline, or start fresh.

data_description.attach_tracker_id: Attaching continues the archived timeline under this tracker. Start fresh leaves the archive untouched — it stays in the database and can be attached later (or deleted via the repair flow). If the selected entity already has archived data, start fresh is not possible.

error.missing_coordinates: The selected entity does not expose latitude/longitude attributes.
error.orphan_unavailable: That archived data is no longer available — it may have been deleted meanwhile. Pick another entry or start fresh.
error.adopt_conflict: The selected entity already has archived data owned by another tracker; both rows were left untouched. Delete or re-home the other tracker first.

abort.already_configured: This entity is already tracked by GPS Timeline.

corrupt_database.title: GPS Timeline database was corrupted
corrupt_database.description: The GPS Timeline database could not be opened. The corrupt file was moved to `{backup_path}` and a new empty database was created. Location history archived before this point is only available in the backup file.

stale_timeline_data.title: Archived GPS Timeline data for {entity_id}
stale_timeline_data.description: The GPS Timeline tracker for `{entity_id}` was removed, but its archived location history and companion states are still stored in the database and are not displayed anywhere. Use the confirm button to decide whether to delete the data permanently or keep it. Keeping it is safe: the archive stays in the database and can be attached again when the subject is added to GPS Timeline again.

confirm.title: Delete archived history for {entity_id}?
confirm.description: This permanently deletes all archived locations and companion states for `{entity_id}` from the GPS Timeline database. Keeping the data is the safe default: it stays in the database and becomes selectable again when the subject is added to GPS Timeline. This action cannot be undone.

data_description.delete_data: Leave this off to keep the archived data (recommended).

error.purge_failed: The database could not be written (it may be locked by another process). Nothing was deleted; try again.

backfill.name: Backfill history from recorder
backfill.description: Imports existing location history from the Home Assistant recorder database into the GPS Timeline archive.

entity_id.name: Tracker entity
entity_id.description: The entity tracked by GPS Timeline whose history should be imported.

start_time.name: Start time
start_time.description: Earliest point to import. Defaults to 10 days before the end time.

end_time.name: End time
end_time.description: Latest point to import. Defaults to now.

purge.name: Delete archived data
purge.description: Permanently deletes the archived location history (points and companion states) for an entity. This cannot be undone.

entity_id.name: Tracker entity
entity_id.description: The entity whose archived history should be deleted. Deleting a live tracker's history reloads it with an empty timeline.
